business_summary: Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the management of food service chain restaurants, and development of sales systems and food processing systems in Japan, the United States, China, Europe, ASEAN, and internationally. It operates through Global Sukiya, Global Hama Sushi, Global Prepared Food, Global Fast Food, Restaurants, Retail, Head Office and Support, and Other segments. The company's restaurants offer gyudon, udon, tempura, shabu-shabu, hamburger steaks, pasta, noodles, desserts, and drinks, as well as provides conveyor-belt sushi restaurant, coffee shop, and dining services under the Sukiya, Nakau, Coco's, Big Boy, Victoria Station, Jolly Pasta, EI Torito, Hama-sushi, Hanaya Yohei, Denmaru, Kyubeiya, Jukusei Yakiniku Ichiban, Katsu-An, and Olive Hill brands. It also operates Chicken Rice Shop, as well as sells products under AFC, ZENSHI, SNOWFOX, SNOWFRUIT, Bento, YO!, Taiko, SushiTake, and Sushi Circle brands. In addition, the company operates supermarket chains under Joy Foods, United Veggies, Maruya, Attack, Fujimart, Maruei, and Very Foods Owariya brand names; and offers residential and nursing care services for the elderly under Kagayaki, Royalhouse Ishioka, Enju, NYEREG, and IMedicare brand names. Further, it engages in the manufacturing and processing of food ingredients; logistics; store equipment installation and maintenance; uniforms, and other related items under GFF, Zensho Shoji, Global Fresh Supply, Techno Construction, and Global Table Supply brands. The company was formerly known as Zensho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2011. Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd.는 일본, 미국, 중국, 유럽, ASEAN 및 국제적으로 식품 서비스 체인 레스토랑 관리, 판매 시스템 및 식품 가공 시스템 개발에 참여하고 있습니다. Global Sukiya, Global Hama Sushi, Global Ready Food, Global Fast Food, 레스토랑, 소매, 본사 및 지원 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 자사 레스토랑에서는 규동, 우동, 튀김, 샤브샤브, 함박스테이크, 파스타, 면류, 디저트, 음료를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 Sukiya, Nakau, Coco's, Big Boy, Victoria Station, Jolly Pasta, EI Torito, Hama-sushi, Hanaya Yohei, Denmaru, Kyubeiya, Jukusei Yakiniku 아래 회전초밥 레스토랑, 커피숍, 다이닝 서비스도 제공합니다. 이치반, 가쓰안, 올리브힐 브랜드입니다. 또한 치킨 라이스 매장을 운영할 뿐만 아니라 AFC, ZENSHI, SNOWFOX, SNOWFRUIT, Bento, YO!, Taiko, SushiTake 및 Sushi Circle 브랜드로 제품을 판매합니다. 또한 회사는 Joy Foods, United Veggies, Maruya, Attack, Fujimart, Maruei 및 Very Foods Owariya 브랜드 이름으로 슈퍼마켓 체인을 운영하고 있습니다. Kagayaki, Royalhouse Ishioka, Enju, NYER에서 노인을 위한 주거 및 간호 서비스를 제공합니다.
